_what: The perf ladder's regression baseline — M154e step 5, see scripts/verify-perf-baseline.mjs.
_bands: Ratios of tflw to its co-runner in the SAME run (D750), never absolute numbers: absolutes on this box move with thermal state, the 2.4 GHz link and whoever else holds the lease. null means not yet measured.
_establishing: The first scheduled box run records observed ratios in its artifact; a human promotes them here and flips `established`. That run is also what closes B6-15, whose condition is "reopens when the parity ladder is next run in anger".
